_comment: Real-KataGo ladder for 9x9, Chinese rules, komi 7.5 (MISSION.md section 2). Serve it with the strong net engines/models/kata1-tf3-b11c768-s11003M-d5973M-7gres.bin.gz (GPU, through kgservice: scripts/arena_up.sh); the tier file cannot check the net, the arena command line must. Every tier is unrated (counts_for_rating false). k1-* are UNCALIBRATED: no Elo is claimed for them. random/greedy keep their measured Elo from config/tiers-9x9.json (2026-10-05, b10c128 pool, anchor random = 0). Semantics (goarena/opponents.py): temperature 0 with visits 1 plays the argmax of the raw policy over legal moves that do not fill an own eye (no sampling); root_symmetries 8 averages the root network evaluation over all 8 board symmetries, so k1-p's move is a fixed function of the position instead of depending on the random symmetry (nnRandomize) of whichever backend evaluates it. With visits > 1 and temperature 0 the tier plays KataGo's best move. After an agent pass, tiers with fewer than 16 visits decide whether to pass with a 32-visit check. KataGo tiers resign at own winrate < 2% and lead < -15 for 3 consecutive moves after ply 27 (TierSpec defaults).
